scenario.title: 聊接案、斜槓和自由工作
scenario.context: 聊自由接案時，常會強調重點：「我最喜歡的是時間自由」「我需要的是穩定的客戶」。英文用 What I love is… / What I need is… 這種名詞子句把重點放在句尾，聽起來更有說服力，也是很好用的簡報句型。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I'm a freelance illustrator. I work mostly with food brands.
lines.zh: 我是自由插畫家，主要跟餐飲品牌合作。

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.en: Nice! Was that always the plan?
lines.zh: 不錯！一開始就是這樣計畫的嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Not at all. It started as a side hustle while I was working at an agency.
lines.zh: 完全不是。一開始是我在廣告公司工作時的副業。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What I realized was that I had more fun doing my own gigs than my day job.
lines.zh: 我發現的是，做自己的案子比做正職開心多了。

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.en: Being your own boss must be great.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What I love is the freedom. What I don't love is chasing invoices.
lines.zh: 我喜歡的是自由，不喜歡的是追款項。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: I'm thinking of starting a side hustle. Any tips?
lines.zh: 我在考慮開始做副業，有什麼建議嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What matters most is having a few steady clients before you quit.
lines.zh: 最重要的是在辭職前先有幾個穩定的客戶。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What nobody tells you is how much time admin takes. Contracts, taxes, emails…
lines.zh: 沒人告訴你的是行政有多花時間：合約、報稅、回信……

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Ugh. I just want to hustle and make stuff.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What you need, then, is a good system. I'll show you mine.
lines.zh: 那你需要的是一套好的系統，我給你看我的。

patterns.en: What I love about it is ___.
It started as a side project.

chinglish.wrong: The thing I like is freedom is very important.
chinglish.right: What I like is the freedom.
chinglish.why: 中文「我喜歡的是自由」直翻時常多加一個動詞。What I like is + 名詞 就夠了。

chinglish.wrong: What I need is have more clients.
chinglish.right: What I need is more clients. / What I need is to find more clients.
chinglish.why: is 後面接名詞或 to V，不能直接接原形動詞。

chinglish.right: I have a few side hustles. / I have a portfolio career.
chinglish.why: 「斜槓青年」是中文特有說法，英文不這樣說。

chinglish.right: I freelance. / I take on freelance projects.
chinglish.why: 「接案」直翻 do case 不是英文。

grammar.title: 名詞子句 What I need is…
grammar.oneLiner: What + 主詞 + 動詞 可以當成一個名詞（= the thing that），放在句首把重點延到句尾。
whenToUse: What 子句當主詞：What I love is the freedom.
What 子句當受詞：I don't know what I want. / That's exactly what I meant.
What… is / was + 名詞 / to V / that 子句：What I need is to rest. / What surprised me was that nobody complained.
動詞用單數（is / was），因為整個 What 子句算一件事。
這種句型在簡報、面試、寫作中很有力：What makes us different is…
注意語序：What I need（不是 What do I need）。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文「我需要的是…」「讓我意外的是…」的結構很常見，但台灣人翻成英文時常用 The thing that… 或把問句語序帶進來（What do I need is…）。其實 What + 肯定語序就能當名詞用，和第 27 單元的間接問句是同樣的語序規則。

examples.correct: What I need is a break.
examples.incorrect: What do I need is a break.

examples.correct: What surprised me was how friendly everyone was.
What makes our studio different is our focus on food brands.
What I want to do is start my own studio.

quiz.question: ___ is more time with my family.
___ surprised me was how fast it grew.
What I need ___ a better laptop.
quiz.explanation: What 子句當主詞用單數 is。

quiz.question: What I want ___ do is travel for a year.
quiz.explanation: What I want to do is…

slang.usage: 正職以外賺錢的工作，通常帶有熱情或創業意味。

risk.note: 很普遍，但跟正職主管提到時要注意公司規定。

examples.en: My side hustle is selling illustrated stickers online.
examples.zh: 我的副業是在網路上賣插畫貼紙。

examples.en: Her side hustle eventually became her full-time job.
examples.zh: 她的副業最後變成全職工作。

slang.usage: a gig = 一份臨時工作或一場演出。gig economy = 零工經濟。

examples.en: I got a new gig designing a menu for a café.
examples.zh: 我接到一個幫咖啡店設計菜單的新案子。

examples.en: The band has a gig on Saturday.

slang.usage: 動詞 hustle = 很拚；名詞 the hustle。注意 hustle 也有「詐騙」的意思，看語境。

risk.note: hustle culture（拚命文化）現在常被批評；說某人 hustled you 是指被騙。

examples.en: She really hustled to get her business off the ground.
examples.zh: 她為了讓事業起步真的很拚。

examples.en: I'm tired of the hustle. I want balance.
examples.zh: 我厭倦了拚命的日子，我想要平衡。

slang.usage: 自由接案或創業，不受雇於人。

examples.en: Being your own boss sounds great until tax season.
examples.zh: 自己當老闆聽起來很棒，直到報稅季。

examples.en: I've always wanted to be my own boss.

review.question: I ___ work at an agency, but now I freelance.
review.explanation: 複習第 58 單元：used to + 原形。

review.question: My first client, ___ runs a bakery, still hires me.
review.explanation: 複習第 57 單元：非限定子句用 who。

review.question: We need to figure ___ how to price this project.
I ___ with over forty clients since I started freelancing.
review.explanation: 複習第 51 單元：since 用現在完成式。

review.question: There ___ to be a mistake on your invoice.
review.explanation: 複習第 43 單元：There seems to be。

review.question: Could you tell me ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 27 單元：間接問句用肯定語序。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: What do I need is more sleep.
What I need is more sleep.
What I need are more sleep.
review.explanation: What 子句：肯定語序 + is。
